review.summary: The plan references several modules, services, and data models that are not currently grounded in the system_state.json file.

findings.title: Ungrounded module reference: navigationRegistry.ts
findings.evidence: The plan introduces `src/config/navigationRegistry.ts` without evidence of its existence in the current repo.
findings.requiredAction: Create and ground `navigationRegistry.ts` in system_state.json before implementation.

findings.title: Ungrounded module reference: route wrappers
findings.evidence: The plan mentions refactoring route wrappers, but there is no evidence of these existing in the current repo.
findings.requiredAction: Create and ground any necessary route wrapper modules in system_state.json before implementation.

findings.title: Ungrounded module reference: section shell pages
findings.evidence: The plan introduces new IA sections without evidence of these existing in the current repo.
findings.requiredAction: Create and ground any necessary section shell page modules in system_state.json before implementation.

findings.title: Ungrounded module reference: card taxonomy
findings.evidence: The plan mentions converging card systems without evidence of existing card modules.
findings.requiredAction: Create and ground any necessary card modules in system_state.json before implementation.

requiredAction: Escalate to Copilot for manual intervention beyond Dr Bob auto-fix scope.
